title: Grateful Dead Live at Knickerbocker Arena on 1991-03-23
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Sound Forge 13 Pro (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Crisp matrix recording of a 1991 New York show, notable for Bruce Hornsby's absence but otherwise enjoyable.
ai_review.review: The ultramatrix source captures a nice, crisp sound that fans appreciate, delivering clear audio despite the lack of keyboardist Bruce Hornsby on this date. Reviewers are enthusiastic about the overall performance and recommend it even though they note the missing horns, making it a solid listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises both sound quality and overall enjoyment; strong recording quality and positive show impression justify a high rating, but confidence is medium due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as 'nice' and 'crisp' with no reported issues; ultramatrix suggests a blend of board and audience providing clear audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewer simply notes overall enjoyment despite the missing keyboardist.
